name: Lord Clarmont
source:
Nation: Revaire

"I declare myself all admiration and a happy man indeed to have met you."

The handsome young lord seems different than the rest of his Revaire counterparts. Charming and considerate, occasionally he seems to have a hidden bite. Still, he must have some favor with the current court, or he wouldn’t be here. It should be interesting to see his true objective at the Summit.
